commits.subject: test(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Every coverage link in live-animals, plants, ins and admin names a test that exists
feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): The live animals and plants scenarios whose wording the application contradicts say what the application does, and are proven
feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Live animals specs merged from main carry this branch's proven coverage, and spec lint is clean
test(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Every high-risk plants journey-flow and journey-pages scenario left partial is proven by a test that fails when the behaviour breaks
test(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Live animals page endings while amending, trail round trips and page content scenarios are proven by tests that fail when they break

test(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Live animals CPH, transporter add pages, What are you importing? returns, Save and continue landings and the entry guard are proven by tests that fail when they break
test(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Each live animals page's Back, the review's Back and the origin page's Back are proven by tests that fail when the trail is ignored
feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Every journey test proves exactly where Save and continue and Back land, and the routing scenarios in both journey specs are proven

feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Save and continue never opens a page whose earlier required answers are missing, and both frontends' rulings ledger, routing docs and review page Change links say and do one thing
feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Each journey routes by one page order with no run record, and both frontends' routing docs, add-a-page recipes and the plants rulings ledger describe the one rule

feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): Every page in both journeys: Back goes to wherever the trader came from, sub-page round trips keep it, the review page's Back follows the same trail, and each page's own Save and continue and amend endings follow the one rule

feat(eudpa-774-save-and-continue): One page order: Save and continue goes on to the next page that applies from every start, Change links and amendments carry on to the review page, and amend pages show the draft controls

rows.title: One page order: Save and continue goes on to the next page that applies from every start, Change links and amendments carry on to the review page, and amend pages show the draft controls
rows.gate: Check that each frontend derives the next page from one ordered list of pages with their gates that matches Overview's task list, that the change shortcut back to the review page and the task-row next-page rule are gone rather than bypassed, that the entry guard admits on an entered answer alone, and that an amend page renders the same endings as its draft version from one place in each frontend's shared save controls, with the amend form actions that post straight back to the review page gone, not hidden. The Back row and the removal row build on this.

rows.title: Every page in both journeys: Back goes to wherever the trader came from, sub-page round trips keep it, the review page's Back follows the same trail, and each page's own Save and continue and amend endings follow the one rule
rows.gate: Check how where-the-trader-came-from is carried in one shape on Overview links, Change links, error-summary links, dashboard card links, the links into the review page, the create and start redirects, the plants review page's Continue form, each page's form post and every sub-page round trip; that the Back link is worked out in one place in each frontend's shared kit, the review page included; and that a missing or unrecognised marker falls back rather than refuses. Then open the live animals origin, What are you importing?, main import reason, Transporter details and Upload documents pages and the high-risk plants commodity type and commodities list from a review page Change link and while amending: Save and continue walks on, Back returns to the review page, and the amend endings match the draft. Every other page in the row copies this pattern. On Upload documents, check that every link and redirect that brings the page back to itself (upload return, Save and add another, remove, refresh status, an unopened upload) and every add-a-transporter, CPH, party picker and edit address round trip carries the trader's origin rather than rebuilding it from a fixed list.
